Design Cassandra cluster topology and perform capacity planning based on application workloads, scalability, availability, and performance requirements. Perform Cassandra performance analysis and tuning to optimize read/write performance, throughput, and latency. Tune Cassandra compaction strategies, caching, consistency levels, tombstones, SSTables, and database configuration parameters. Identify and resolve hot partitions, slow queries, high latency, and database or infrastructure resource bottlenecks. Manage Cassandra cluster lifecycle activities including installations, upgrades, migrations, patching, capacity expansion, and configuration changes. Add, replace, remove, and safely decommission Cassandra nodes while maintaining cluster availability and data integrity. Perform cluster expansion and capacity upgrades with minimal production impact. Manage token distribution, node bootstrap and streaming, repair, cleanup, and cluster rebalancing activities. Implement and maintain Cassandra backup and restore strategies, including snapshots and incremental backups. Develop and support disaster-recovery procedures and ensure Cassandra environments meet availability and business continuity requirements. Tune Cassandra JVM heap, garbage collection, memory, and related configuration settings. Troubleshoot JVM and system-level issues including GC pauses, heap pressure, CPU utilization, disk I/O, memory, and storage performance. Monitor Cassandra cluster health, availability, latency, throughput, disk usage, compactions, dropped messages, GC activity, repairs, and overall capacity. Develop and implement database automation solutions to streamline administration, deployment, maintenance, monitoring, and operational processes. Support distributed and highly available database environments while ensuring reliability, resiliency, and fault tolerance. Contribute to database standards, governance practices, operational procedures, and engineering best practices. Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to improve visibility into database health and performance. Participate in cloud adoption initiatives and support Cassandra database workloads across modern cloud platforms.
